<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Kid Trunks''' is the young Trunks of the Buu Saga. In game he is simply called '''Trunks''' (and '''Trunks (Super Saiyan)'''); this page is titled Kid Trunks because [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Trunks]] is the page of the adult Trunks, a master. He is one of the Buu Saga fighters of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]] and a story opponent in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Kid Trunks can be drawn as a '''contender''' in the Otherworld Tournament. Each contender seat draws a random fighter from the Buu Saga cast, and a tournament never has two forms of the same character, so it has at most one Trunks: base or Super Saiyan. The draw is revealed once everybody accepts the rules, and you only face him if he reaches your bout: fights between two NPCs are decided automatically.

<!--T:9-->
His stats come from the tournament, not from the character: each contender draw has its own health, damage and AI tier. By default they range from 238,000 health, 9,900 melee damage and 8,840 ki damage (Smart AI) to 612,500 health, 25,800 melee damage and 23,460 ki damage (Elite AI), and contenders get 8% stronger for every round already played.

<!--T:10-->
Tournament fighters never transform: Trunks keeps the form he was drawn in for the whole bout. Bouts end at knockout, so he isn't killed and drops nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Kid Trunks is child-sized and flies. His AI tier comes from the tournament draw or, in story quests, from your difficulty (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]). Both forms share the same kit:

<!--T:13-->
* '''Ki attacks:''' Ki Volley and Ki Blast, light blue in his base form and yellow as a Super Saiyan.
* '''Combos:''' none; he fights with plain melee.
* '''Mobility:''' he backsteps away from your hits.
</translate>

<translate>
== Forms == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
Kid Trunks has two forms, each a separate entity: '''Trunks''' (base) and '''Trunks (Super Saiyan)'''. In the tournament each form is drawn on its own and stays as it is. In story quests he starts in his base form and turns Super Saiyan partway through the fight.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
Kid Trunks is fought in three story quests. In all of them he starts in his base form and, by default at half health, turns Super Saiyan and comes back at full health with stronger stats.

<!--T:19-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 3, ''Trunks and Vegeta Training'', together with Vegeta.
* Buu Saga quest 6, ''Tournament: Trunks'', on the plains.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] quest 31, ''Goten and Trunks'', in the snowy plains, together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Goten|Goten]].

<!--T:20-->
Future Trunks and the adult Trunks of the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] are separate entities.
</translate>
